shortcuts.name: PDF Export
shortcuts.summary: Share sheet action. Turns text, images, a web page or a file into a PDF, then asks: Preview it, Save it through the Files save dialog, or Share it.

shortcuts.name: Audio Extract
shortcuts.summary: Share sheet action. Pulls the audio track out of a video as an M4A and opens it in Quick Look, ready to share or save.

shortcuts.name: Busy Redialer
shortcuts.summary: Share sheet action. Dials a phone number again and again until the call connects, so a busy hotline redials itself. Asks how many attempts first.
